definition: An origin is the last month whose data may be used. The target is the next month. A model for an origin is fit on target months up to and including the origin, so no value from the target month or later enters the fit.
training_rule_main: target months in the pre-pandemic and post-pandemic periods, from the first trainable target up to the origin
training_rule_sensitivity: the same, with pandemic-period target months kept
use_of_validation: SARIMAX orders and LightGBM hyperparameters are chosen on the validation origins only and are then fixed for every test origin
use_of_test: each test origin is forecast once, after the choices above are fixed
